items.decisiveFact: A shipping team’s label service builds a label after an address correction. Shipment owns the approved address and package dimensions; the current printer service reads both fields to decide which label values to include.
items.nearestAlternative: Keep the decision in the printer service and give it more shipment fields, so other callers can share the same implementation.
